expect.header: Calm is part ofddd the celebration
expect.bodytext: Easter does not only belong to activity. It also belongs to softer pauses, quieter rooms, and moments of tenderness. Rabbit imagery can help tell that version of the holiday with very little effort.

expect.header: How to use gentle spring visuals
expect.bodytext:
• Keep the copy warm and direct instead of playful and loud.
  • Use pale neutrals and natural textures around the image.
  • Focus on care, stillness, and closeness.
  • Let one visual do the emotional work rather than many props.

expect.header: Soft imagery slows the whole page down
expect.bodytext: Not every Easter post needs bright color or obvious festivity. A softer image, like rabbits held gently in spring light, can shift the mood toward calm, care, and quiet presence. That tone is especially useful when the aim is to make Easter feel reflective rather than purely decorative.
